text: Carissime, ne imitare malum, sed bonum. Qui bene facit, a Deo est: qui vero male facit, Deum non novit.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 1:9–10 on Diotrephes end, and *Cārissime, nē imitāre malum* turns to the exhortation and Demetrius (1:11–12), a new address; the BSB's breaks at 1:2 (the wish runs on to 1:4) and 1:12 (Demetrius, the example of 1:11) left (Claude, 2026-11-12)
